# Marten

> Marten is a batteries-included web framework for Crystal. This file indexes the guides for the version under development.

The full text of these guides is at https://martenframework.com/docs/llms-full.txt. These URLs are the in-development guides at https://martenframework.com/docs/next/. The latest stable guides are at https://martenframework.com/docs/. The generated API reference for this version is at https://martenframework.com/docs/api/dev/.

## Prologue

- [Prologue](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/): What Marten is, and how the guides, how-tos, and reference pages differ.

## Getting Started

- [Getting Started](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/getting-started): Learn how to install Marten and create a first project.
- [Installation](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/getting-started/installation): Get started by installing Marten and its dependencies.
- [Tutorial](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/getting-started/tutorial): Learn how to use Marten by creating a simple web application.
- [Coming from Django?](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/getting-started/from-django): A concept map for developers already familiar with Django.
- [Coming from Rails?](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/getting-started/from-rails): A concept map for developers already familiar with Ruby on Rails.

## Models and databases

- [Models and databases](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/models-and-databases): Learn how models define and persist the data in a Marten application.
- [Introduction to models](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/models-and-databases/introduction): Learn how to define models and interact with model records.
- [Querying model records](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/models-and-databases/queries): Learn how to query model records.
- [Relationships](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/models-and-databases/relationships): Learn how to define relationships in models.
- [Model validations](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/models-and-databases/validations): Learn how to validate model records.
- [Model callbacks](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/models-and-databases/callbacks): Learn how to define model callbacks.
- [Model migrations](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/models-and-databases/migrations): Learn how to generate and work with model migrations.
- [Database transactions](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/models-and-databases/transactions): Learn how to leverage database transactions.
- [Performing raw SQL queries](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/models-and-databases/raw-sql): Learn how to perform raw SQL queries.
- [Multiple databases](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/models-and-databases/multiple-databases): Learn how to leverage multiple databases in a Marten project.
- [Create custom model fields](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/models-and-databases/how-to/create-custom-model-fields): How to create custom model fields.
- [Create custom field predicates](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/models-and-databases/how-to/create-custom-field-predicates): How to create custom field predicates.
- [Model fields](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/models-and-databases/reference/fields): Model fields reference.
- [Table options](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/models-and-databases/reference/table-options): Table options reference.
- [Query set](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/models-and-databases/reference/query-set): Query set reference.
- [Migration operations](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/models-and-databases/reference/migration-operations): Migration operations reference.

## Handlers and HTTP

- [Handlers and HTTP](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/handlers-and-http): Learn how handlers process requests and return responses.
- [Introduction to handlers](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/handlers-and-http/introduction): Learn how to define handlers and respond to HTTP requests.
- [Routing](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/handlers-and-http/routing): Learn how to map handlers to routes.
- [Generic handlers](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/handlers-and-http/generic-handlers): Learn how to leverage generic handlers to perform common tasks.
- [Error handlers](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/handlers-and-http/error-handlers): Learn about the built-in error handlers and how to configure them.
- [Sessions](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/handlers-and-http/sessions): Learn how to use sessions to persist data between requests.
- [Cookies](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/handlers-and-http/cookies): Learn how to use cookies to persist data on the client.
- [Handler callbacks](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/handlers-and-http/callbacks): Learn how to define handler callbacks.
- [Middlewares](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/handlers-and-http/middlewares): Learn how to leverage middlewares to alter HTTP requests and responses.
- [Customize handler template contexts](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/handlers-and-http/how-to/customize-handler-template-contexts): How to customize handler template contexts.
- [Create custom route parameters](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/handlers-and-http/how-to/create-custom-route-parameters): How to create custom route parameters.
- [Build a JSON API](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/handlers-and-http/how-to/build-a-json-api): How to build a JSON API.
- [Generic handlers](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/handlers-and-http/reference/generic-handlers): Generic handlers reference
- [Middlewares](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/handlers-and-http/reference/middlewares): Middlewares reference

## Security

- [Security](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/security): Learn about the security measures Marten provides.
- [Security in Marten](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/security/introduction): Learn about the main security features provided by the Marten framework.
- [Cross-Site Request Forgery protection](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/security/csrf): Learn about Cross-Site Request Forgeries (CSRF) attacks and how to protect your application from them.
- [Clickjacking protection](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/security/clickjacking): Learn about clickjacking and how Marten helps protect against this type of attacks.
- [Content Security Policy](https://martenframework.com/docs/next/security/content-security-policy): Learn how to configure the Content-Security-Policy (CSP) header.
